name: Joseph Lambert
original_name: ジョセフ・ランバート
source: Souji and Arisu's classmate. Even though he has a European appearance, he is actually a hafu born in Saitama. Not good in English, wasn't born from a wealthy family, but was invited to the school due to his boxing talent.
